info.name: Zamna Ready To Fly Session Start2 API
For in-browser redirect — initiate MultiPax session with encrypted booking id, redirect browser to URL with session token to authorize further requests

params.name: redirect_url
params.description: URL to redirect to with auth token as query param

params.name: return_url
params.description: URL to return after passengers are Ready To Fly, or in case of errors

params.name: pax_ids
params.description: comma-separated list of pax ids to load from booking (if not specified, all pax will be loaded)

params.name: consented
params.description: Whether consent should be set for session, true/false

params.name: locale
params.description: Locale to redirect with (locale parameter is added to redirect_url)

params.name: language
params.description: Alias for 'locale'. Locale to redirect with (locale parameter is added to redirect_url)

params.name: mode
params.description: Mode to pass through to webview (mode parameter is added to redirect_url)

params.name: departure_station
params.description: Departure station to select journey by (if not specified, first in future journey will be selected)

params.name: departureCity
params.description: Alias for departure_station. Departure station to select journey by (if not specified, first in future journey will be selected)

params.name: encryption_mode
params.description: Encryption mode to use for booking id decryption. If omitted used the only one configured, or else AES_CBC if multiple modes are configured.
